import { default as _init, initSync, PgletBtree } from './pglet_wasm.js';
import { wrap_pglet_db } from './db.js';

let _ready = false;
// The one in-flight initialization: wasm-bindgen's own init only checks for a finished module, so a
// second load started before the first finished would replace the module under a live instance.
let _loading = null;
function _check() {
	if (!_ready) throw new Error('@fuzdev/pglet-wasm: WASM not initialized. Call `await init()` first.');
}
export function init(options) {
	if (_ready) return Promise.resolve();
	_loading ??= _init(options?.wasm === undefined ? undefined : { module_or_path: options.wasm }).then(
		() => {
			_ready = true;
		},
		(e) => {
			_loading = null;
			throw e;
		},
	);
	return _loading;
}
export function init_sync(options) {
	if (_ready) return;
	if (_loading) throw new Error('@fuzdev/pglet-wasm: init_sync() was called while init() is loading the module; await init() instead');
	if (options?.wasm === undefined) {
		throw new Error('@fuzdev/pglet-wasm: init_sync() needs {wasm}: the module bytes or a compiled WebAssembly.Module');
	}
	initSync({ module: options.wasm });
	_ready = true;
}
export function create_pglet_db(options) {
	_check();
	return wrap_pglet_db(new PgletBtree(), options);
}
